text:
Mira: quick thread  prototype idea: an "estimated $/call" tile on Console that accounts for token unit price, KV cache savings, and any routing fallbacks. goal: low-friction signal for product owners.
Dan: telemetry caution  full per-call attribution is high-cardinality. we need bounded rollups + sampling.
Priya: propose stratified sampling: guarantee N samples/minute per route, then random 0.5% beyond. That keeps small routes visible.
Hector: rollup shape suggestion: minute_rollup with keys (route, model_sku, cache_bucket, fallback_flag) and fields: prefix_tokens, gen_tokens, sample_count. coarse cache_bucket like none/low/med/high.
Mira: UX: show single estimated value + sparkline. expand shows model split and cache %. tooltip: "estimate from sampled telemetry; click to reconcile with invoice exports."
Dan: extrapolation sketch (nightly job):
```
SELECT route, model_sku, SUM(sample_prefix+sample_gen) * (route_total_calls / SUM(sample_count)) as est_tokens
FROM sampled_rollups JOIN route_totals USING(route,model_sku)
GROUP BY route,model_sku;
```
Priya: also apply historical unit-price per model_sku when converting tokens to $. keep price cache in the job.
Hector: flag when fallback_rate > 10% in the tile (orange warning). lowered $/call from fallbacks can be misleading without quality context.
Mira: action items: 1) infra: implement stratified sampler (Priya), 2) platform: nightly extrapolation + price-apply (Dan), 3) runtime: emit fallback_flag (Hector), 4) product: mock + microcopy (Mira). I'll file PLAT-9977 and assign.
ui-bot: mock uploaded: https://console.redwood.ai/proto/est-cost-tile  note: uses sampled data.
Mira: timeline: stub demo next Tue, canary sampler Wed. thanks all. :thumbsup:
